about: History Basic wording test T8 (FR-7a, FR-7b): the History wording grep. capsule-viewer's tests read this file; other lints may reuse it. Only the phrases the rc16 item names are listed.

banned_deal_status.note: Never used as a deal's status in a History Basic string. Matched case-insensitively, as whole words, over every line of the module's source (history_card.js and src/capsule_viewer/history/*) and over the text the module renders for every fixture.

similarity_claim.note: No similarity claim (FR-7b): no History string may say or imply that the presented deals resemble an item under discussion, or that the key's holder has experience with such items. Tested as these case-insensitive patterns (this repository's own, not copied text), over the same strings, with 0 hits.
